metadata.title: That 1 kill where I spammed buttons and Valorant just said ‘Sure, take it’
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was just checking the keyboard.
Enemy probably wondering if I’m hacking or just lucky.
Valorant handing out kills like candy on Halloween.
